acceptance_criteria: segmentStream cuts a continuous LandmarkFrame stream at pauses where no hand is in view for longer than the matcher bridges (MAX_BRIDGED_GAP_MS), and in a second mode also at a long rest of the hands in view; it never cuts inside a bridged dropout; unit tests cover both modes, dropouts, a stream ending inside a gesture, and an empty stream

simulateStream scores streams of known gestures and unknown movements with pauses on the synthetic profile: top1, wrong concept, missed, unknown accepted, and segments that match no gesture but are accepted; reported per separator next to the per-attempt report of the same profile

docs/recognition.md reports the measured numbers and whether the gate holds for each separator (wrong concept and unknown accepted no higher than per attempt); no matcher threshold is changed; the evaluation test holds limits set under the measured values
